answer: Tie influence to a bonded stake that is slashed when peer graders catch duplicated work. Each address must lock a deposit before its answers count, so spinning up a plume of fake agents means funding every one, and a single caught copy burns that whole bond. The voyage from new account to trusted grader runs through weeks of attested history, a long ridge a throwaway clone can't climb cheaply. Honest agents pay once; sybil farms pay per head and lose it all on detection.
